title: FB-023 require strict boolean command confirmations
summary: Fixed FR-018 by making rename apply and final-library promote confirmation fields strict optional booleans at the Local API command contract boundary.
reason: Worker findings W06-02/W06-03 showed high-risk confirmation fields accepted strings and integers at route validation because they were typed as Any.
behavior_before: Route payload validation accepted non-boolean values such as "false" or 1 for rename apply and final-library promote confirmation fields, relying on downstream handlers to fail closed.
behavior_after: Rename apply confirm_apply, rename outside-root override, and final-library promote confirm_promote are StrictBool | None fields, rejecting non-boolean strings/integers before command dispatch.
manual_validation: targeted Local API rename outside-root confirmation test passed
